stem.text: Pinenes are unsaturated compounds. The structures of two pinenes are shown.

stem.label: α-pinene
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of α-pinene: a bicyclic ring system with a gem-dimethyl bridge carbon and an exocyclic-to-ring C=C bearing a methyl group

stem.label: β-pinene
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of β-pinene: a bicyclic ring system with a gem-dimethyl bridge carbon and an exocyclic C=CH2 group

stem.text: A mixture of these two pinenes reacts with hot concentrated acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$.
What are the molecular formulae of the organic products?
